text: {"assertions":["On 2026-04-25, a double counting bug was discovered in analytics/etl/rollup.sql on the staging read replica.","The double counting bug was caused by a mutable default argument shared across multiple function calls.","The bug was detected because rollup totals exceeded the source table totals.","The fix was deployed in PR #1487 on branch fix/double-counting-1, which changed the mutable default to be empty and built the value per call instead.","The bug could be reproduced by rerunning the rollup for a day that was already loaded.","The rollup reconciliation check in the CI pipeline is the covering test for this type of issue.","The backlog cleared 27 minutes after the fix was deployed."]}
